verdict.rationale: Fathom's own webhooks can push each meeting's AI-generated action items to a URL of your choice. Its REST API, SDKs and official MCP server let an agent read meeting data, so an agent or glue service can file those items into a tracker. However, nothing in the evidence shows a native Linear, Jira or Asana integration, so the actual filing step must be built by the user. Missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations or automations, documented action-item fields or endpoints in the API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end action-item-to-tracker workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.
Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
